# Limits and constants

*Generated by `node authoring-kit/scripts/limits.mjs` from Story Block limits.*

## A pack file

| What | Limit |
|---|---|
| One pack | 524,288 bytes of UTF-8 |
| Nesting | 16 |
| Object keys | 200 |
| List entries | 1000 |
| String length | 4000 |
| Display name | 80 |
| Slug length | 64 |
| Reported problems | 20 |

## Data modules (interpreter 1)

| What | Limit |
|---|---|
| Definitions in one pack | 8 |
| Pins per chat, subjects per module | 16, 16 |
| One definition | 32,768 bytes of JSON |
| One instance (all its fields and timers) | 16,384 bytes |
| Fields, kinds, rules, timers, reward templates | 32, 16, 32, 8, 16 |
| Expression depth, nodes, effects in a list | 6, 64, 16 |
| Imports, offers | 8, 64 |
| Field, kind and label names | lowercase, at most 40 characters |
| Enum values, map keys, text length | 32, 16, 240 |
| Migration steps | 4 |
| Timer interval (`every`) | 1 to 525,600 minutes |
| Whole numbers in expressions | within plus or minus 1,000,000,000 |
| Actions per reply: data roots, evaluation visits | 32, 16,384 |
| Text the narrator is shown per module | 2,000 characters plus 100 tokens of state |
| Problems listed | 20 |
